Profitability $0.7B GAAP operating income $0.8B GAAP net income $1.7B non-GAAP net income1 In Q3, we maintained strong momentum on many projects spanning Super Intelligence (SI), robotics and renewable energy that will be critical to building a future of Amazing Abundance. Strength in our core business also continued, and we achieved our second consecutive quarter of TTM revenue in excess of $100B. deliveries in North America – our most mature market – a nearly twenty percentage point sequential increase. We believe that FSD is driving demand in markets where it is available, and we continue to work with regulators to get it approved in other markets. We started providing Robotaxi rides using Cybercabs on September 3 in Austin. Cumulative unsupervised Robotaxi miles grew eightfold quarter over quarter, driven by sustained double-digit weekly growth. We ended the quarter with the largest backlog for our passenger vehicles in four years. We rolled out the updated Tesla Semi that is produced on our high-volume manufacturing line in Nevada and unveiled the Next Gen Roadster on October 15. While battery availability continued to be the limiting factor in increasing auto volumes in the quarter, we have made additional progress in securing future supply, as we work toward our goal of maximum utilization of our factories. Demand for our Energy Storage business remained strong in the quarter, with our highest- ever order rate and backlog. Energy storage is the fastest way to add power to the existing grid and is critical to data center uptime. We expect rising data center demand to continue driving demand for our products. Megafactory Texas began production, with planned capacity of 50 GWh. We also advanced LFP supply domestication in the U.S., shipping the first Megapacks built with LFP cells from our factory in Nevada. We continue to invest in the future through R&D and Capex spend across our businesses, including SI, robotics and energy. Much hard work lies ahead, but we are as optimistic as ever. Thank you to our supporters as we continue to execute on many challenging and important projects.
